// diagnostic

E2807

Route `{path}` is registered both by `{a}` and `{b}`.

What

Route `{path}` is registered both by `{a}` and `{b}`.

Why

Explicit builder entries and `.routes(from:)` conventions must not claim the same path (D-WEBAUTHOR1).

Fix

remove one registration, or rename the convention file.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2807: tests/ui/web_app_route_collision.stderr.

Error [E2807]: route `/` is registered both by `builder` and `routes_collision/index.jet`
  --> tests/ui/web_app_route_collision.jet:5:47
    |
  5 | fn run() => App :: web.app().route("/", home).routes(from: "routes_collision").csr()
    |                                               ^^^^^^
 Why: explicit builder entries and `.routes(from:)` conventions must not claim the same path (D-WEBAUTHOR1)
 Fix: remove one registration, or rename the convention file

Error [E2807]: earlier registration of route `/`
  --> tests/ui/web_app_route_collision.jet:5:30
    |
  5 | fn run() => App :: web.app().route("/", home).routes(from: "routes_collision").csr()
    |                              ^^^^^
 Why: both spans are kept so provenance stays audible
 Fix: delete or rename this registration
